blurb: Guests soar above Miami to see iconic landmarks, beaches, and the city skyline from a helicopter. Tours range from 30 minutes to 1 hour with options including downtown, coastal, Everglades, sunset, and private flights. Safety briefings and experienced pilots ensure a secure and memorable experience.
